parent_objective: audit candidate corpus package export before objective design or training
blocked_by: M1615 public pass still requires audit before objective design or training

public_gates: M1616 must audit M1615 package files and metadata
M1616 must decide whether package export admits objective-design, another diagnostic, synthesis, pivot, or stop
M1616 must keep loss construction, training, PPO, promotion, and private holdout blocked during the audit
M1616 must not claim level3 self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1615 package export before objective design or training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no loss/objective construction, training corpus export, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats M1615 as training-ready
stop if audit ignores public-proof metadata
stop if audit routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: admit objective-design only if package metadata and role separation are intact
pivot if public-overfit risk is too high
stop if no next step can preserve guardrails
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1615 passes candidate corpus package export and requires audit

admission_evidence: M1615 passes public gates with candidate package metadata and no training corpus export
allowed_updates: M1616 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits design, synthesis, pivot, or stop
next_stage_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1616 audits public package metadata only and cannot strengthen self-ID claims.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit finds the package too public/narrow, preserve it as artifact evidence instead of objective design.
allowed_claims: M1615 package audit and next route
no promotion, loss/objective construction, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1615's candidate corpus package should be audited before any objective-design, actor-update, training, or PPO decision.
success_criteria: audit records package files and metadata
supported and unsupported claims are explicit
loss construction training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats M1615 as training-ready or promotion evidence
audit routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout objective construction or actor-input changes

supported_claims: M1615 correctly exports a candidate corpus package
positive candidates and diagnostic guardrails remain separated
metadata blocks paper-level, level3, private-holdout, and training-ready claims
the package is eligible for design-only objective planning

decision_rule: M1616 passes if it audits M1615 and chooses the next route before objective construction, training, PPO, or promotion.
